messages:
lauren-support: Customer (AcmeAnalytics) reports requests from EU clients are being routed to US hosts; they see 250-400ms extra latency and occasional 502s. Trace IDs: trace=01-abcd1234.
lauren-support: Quick snippet they sent: `curl -v https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Host: api.eu.redwood.example' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>'`
lauren-support: Response headers include `X-Selected-Region: us-west-2` and `x-request-route: gw-42` even though the request Host is the EU name.
eli-customer: Seeing this in prod since ~09:30 UTC, performance spike correlates. We get higher token latency and billing meter shows tokens counted against us-west pool. Can you confirm?
matt-eng: Ack, looking. Do you have full response headers + decoded trace span?
lauren-support: Pasted truncated resp: ``
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
server: redwood-gw
content-type: application/json
x-selected-region: us-west-2
x-redwood-trace: 01-abcd1234
content-length: 432
``
lauren-support: Customer also included a packet capture showing L7 Host header preserved.
sam-platform: Noted. Last infra change around 09:10 UTC was a routing table tweak for the gw-l7 pool to add a new weight for eu-backend after autoscale. Could be related.
natalie-sre: Can we reproduce locally by forcing Host header? I'll try a curl with Host and compare to `x-redwood-preferred-region` behavior.
matt-eng: Possible bug: gateway LB sets selected-region based on initial upstream assignment, but our header rewrite stage can overwrite it based on a stale route map. If a route map file rotated during the change it might flip region labels.
lauren-support: Repro steps customer allowed us to run: 1) curl with Host header set; 2) observe `x-selected-region` in response; 3) repeat 2-3 times. They got inconsistent region assignments ~30% of requests.
natalie-sre: Running a quick loop now: ``for i in {1..20}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -D - -H 'Host: api.eu.redwood.example' https://gateway.redwood.example/v1/ping | grep -i x-selected-region; done``
(natalie-sre): Results: 14x `x-selected-region: eu-west-1`, 6x `x-selected-region: us-west-2`
lauren-support: That matches customer flakiness.
sam-platform: Reproduced on canary gw-l7 nodes. Looks like a race between routing lookup and header-rewrite plugin that reads a cached map updated asynchronously. If map update happens mid-request we can end up tagging request with previous region label.
matt-eng: Root cause hypothesis: our config hot-reload sequence applies new vhost route table then separately reloads header-mapping plugin; during window some requests hit old plugin with new route table -> header mismatch.
lauren-support: Customer impact: wrong-region tagging -> cross-region billing and higher latency. They're asking for immediate mitigation.
natalie-sre: Short-term mitigation: add a guard to header-rewrite stage to prefer `x-redwood-preferred-region` request header if present, otherwise delay rewrite until mapping confirmed. Implement as a toggle on gw-l7 config.
sam-platform: I can patch canary in 10m. Rolling to all nodes after verification. Need a quick smoke check script to assert stable mapping 100/100 on 50 loops.
matt-eng: Also add logging around map-reload times and a metric for rewrite-mismatch count (when selected-region != computed upstream).
lauren-support: Notifying customer of workaround: they can set `x-redwood-region: eu-west-1` for now to force correct billing/region routing. Mentioning this in the thread: @eli-customer, if you can set that header, it will avoid the race until we roll the fix.
eli-customer: We can add header on our side for now. Appreciate quick response.
deploy-bot: deploy started: gw-l7/header-rewrite-guard v1.2.1 -> canary (nodes: 3) by sam-platform at 2026-03-17T10:45:00Z
sam-platform: Canary metrics look good: 5k requests, no mismatch observed, 0 502s, latency stable. Rolling to remaining pool.
matt-eng: Merged metric dashboard panels: `gw.header_rewrite_mismatch.count` and `gw.map_reload.duration_ms`. Also alerted infra to backfill logs for last 24h.
lauren-support: Closing loop with customer, will follow up with postmortem. Thanks team :thumbsup:
eli-customer: Thanks — we'll monitor and let you know if anything pops up.
lauren-support: Postmortem ticket created: INF-3248 (assigned to sam-platform). Will add timeline and root cause once we have logs.
